notes: New map page. After you pick your hero and press Enter the Dark, you now see all four maps: Gloomwood, Ashen Citadel, Heartfall Belfry and The Weeping Cellar.
Each map card shows what it is like, the foes you will meet, its bosses and its safe-haven town.
Maps you have not unlocked yet are greyed out and say exactly what to do to unlock them. Tap one to see the goal.
Tap an open map to choose it, then Enter the Dark to start. Back takes you to your hero.
The map button on the hero page still works as a quick way to switch maps.
Works with touch, mouse, keyboard (Enter and Esc) and gamepad.
